page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-8-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced resource allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators, and while the storage type is specified as NVMe SSD, the local storage size is listed as None.

The arm64 architecture of the c4a-standard-8-lssd means it lacks x86-specific instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and Intel-specific cryptography or virtualization flags like VMX. This makes the instance reliant on ARM-native instruction sets for cryptographic and vector processing tasks.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for general-purpose workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the resource sharing found in burstable tiers, offering predictable performance for web serving, application hosting, and microservices.
